Hi Alex / Priyanka —

Thanks again for the time today — great first pass through Mediavista's search index / downstream compliance needs. Quick recap to make sure we’re aligned before locking the demo:

- Pain we heard: variable inference latency on peak batches, and audit log retention/visibility requirements for clinical workflows.
- Success criteria you called out: sub-150ms 95th percentile for short queries (<=128 tokens), and end-to-end demonstrable audit logs for model calls.

Next step recommendation: a short (30-minute) intro/demo focused on: product overview, how Redwood handles KV cache and auditing, and a quick QA on integrations. For full technical evaluation we can follow with a deep dive after this.

Proposed 30-minute windows (all listed in ET / PT / BST for convenience):
1) Tue Aug 10 — 11:00am ET / 8:00am PT / 4:00pm BST
2) Wed Aug 11 — 2:00pm ET / 11:00am PT / 7:00pm BST
3) Thu Aug 12 — 9:30am ET / 6:30am PT / 2:30pm BST

Who we'd suggest on our side: myself (sales), Rishi Malhotra (solutions engineer) — Rishi will demo the latency profile and logging flows. If procurement/contract details come up, I’ll loop Monica Patel from CS for continuity.

Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf (short feature summary), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (starter MAP with milestones).

Please reply with the option that works best for you, or share 2 slots that work on your side and we’ll match. If you want a longer tech session, say the word and we’ll schedule a 60-min follow-up.
